name: Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade if
summary: A Japanese romhack of the seventh mainline Fire Emblem game. It tells an alternate story, following the same narrative but with an expanded view, exploring the villains, morphs, and tactician in greater detail. It also replaces pre-existing characters with new ones to better tells its story. The game has been drastically rebalanced; changes include new classes, rebalanced characters, a significantly higher difficulty with inflated enemy stats, and an overhauled weapons system, breaking the stat caps and providing new strategies to break through the intense challenge that awaits.
